title: Spike: how should FieldKit deliver CSV exports to the office
prompt: FieldKit's office staff need surveys out as CSV, but nothing is decided about how exports should work. Spend a short spike on it: read the venture docs, weigh the options, and write your findings as a short note in a new markdown file under docs/. The note must contain a line starting 'Recommendation:' giving one clear recommendation, and every repo path it cites must exist. This is a spike, not a build: change nothing outside docs/.

criteria.desc: A new markdown note under docs/ carries a clear recommendation line
Every repo path the note cites exists

notes: Route intentionally unpinned: a spike is judged on its artefact. c2 guards against invented citations, the cheap failure mode of speculative notes.
